onePlace.heading: Stop juggling five apps for one client.
onePlace.body: Details in Notes, follow-ups in Reminders, viewings in Calendar, documents in Drive, and the real conversation on WhatsApp. LeadWing pulls all of it onto one card per client, so “where did I put that?” stops being a question.
onePlace.caption: Everything about Sofia on one card. Nothing left to hunt for.
onePlace.srSummary: Notes, Reminders, Calendar, Google Drive, spreadsheets, email and WhatsApp all flow into LeadWing, and one complete client card comes out.

features.heading: The whole deal on one card
features.body: Pipeline stage, properties viewed, offers made, documents signed, and which agency the lead came through.

pipeline.title: A pipeline for buyers and sellers
pipeline.body: Drag each client through new, contacted, qualified, viewing and reserved. Sellers get their own flow, pending to qualified.

clients.title: Everything about each client
clients.body: Name, phone, language, nationality, budget and notes. Star the hot ones, hide the cold, and see who to call next.

deal.title: Properties, viewings, offers and documents
deal.body: Log each property a buyer sees, book the viewing, record every offer against the asking price, and keep the contract and IDs on the same card.

agencies.title: One CRM for every agency you sell for
agencies.body: Tag each lead with the agency it came through. Your whole book stays in one place, whoever's listing it is.

howItWorks.heading: How LeadWing works, in three steps
howItWorks.body: Add a client, move them through the pipeline, and let LeadWing handle the follow-up. The whole job, in the order you actually work it.

plan.title: Plan the viewing
plan.blurb: Add a buyer and book the tour. LeadWing keeps the date, the reminder and the bell together — and syncs to your Google Calendar so it shows up everywhere you already look.

pipeline.title: Move them down the pipeline
pipeline.blurb: Drag every buyer through clear stages — new, contacted, qualified, viewing, reserved. Log the offer against the asking price, and watch a deal cross the line.

followUp.title: Let LeadWing follow up
followUp.blurb: LeadWing spots clients going quiet and drafts a warm message in their language. You read it, tweak if you like, and send — no blank page, no chasing.

pipelineStrip.heading: How a buyer moves through your pipeline
pipelineStrip.body: Every buyer follows a simple journey. Move them forward and the right details unlock at each step.
pipelineStrip.note: Sellers get their own flow too — pending to qualified, with every listing attached.

deepDives.heading: WhatsApp, portals and languages, built in with auto follow-up
deepDives.body: The five things that fill an independent agent's day, handled inside LeadWing instead of around it.

whatsapp.title: AI-written WhatsApp messages
whatsapp.body: Tap a client and LeadWing drafts the WhatsApp message for you — warm, personal, and in their language. Read it, tweak it, send it.
whatsapp.point2: Written in the client's own language
whatsapp.point3: You always approve before it sends

match.title: Buyer ↔ listing auto-match
match.body: Because you track buyers and sellers in one place, LeadWing instantly shows which of your listings fit each buyer's budget, type and bedrooms.
match.point2: One tap from buyer to the seller

portal.title: Portal lead capture
portal.body: Paste an enquiry from Idealista, Fotocasa, Kyero, an email or a WhatsApp — LeadWing reads it and fills a ready-to-save lead. No retyping.
portal.point1: Works with any portal, email or WhatsApp
portal.point2: Pulls out name, phone, language & budget
portal.point3: Pre-fills the new-client form for you

speed.title: Multilingual speed-to-lead
speed.body: When a new lead comes in, draft a first reply in their language in one tap — so you're first to respond, not staring at a blank message.

scheduler.title: Viewing scheduler + reminders
scheduler.body: Book viewings and meetings on a clean calendar, get a reminder before each one, and send the client a WhatsApp confirmation in a tap.
scheduler.point1: A simple month calendar for viewings & meetings
scheduler.point3: One-tap WhatsApp confirmation to the client

scheduler.reminder: Reminder: your viewing is tomorrow at 12:00.
scheduler.whatsapp: One tap to send on WhatsApp

ai.heading: Stop chasing. Let LeadWing do the <nowrap>follow-ups.</nowrap>
ai.body: The part every agent dreads — remembering who to email and what to say — handled for you. You stay in control: LeadWing drafts, you approve. No more doing it by hand.

email.title: AI-written, per-client emails
email.body: LeadWing writes a warm, personal email for each client — in their language, referencing their budget, the properties they've seen, and where they are in the journey. No blank page, no copy-paste. You review and send.

nudge.title: Auto-engage forgotten clients
nudge.body: Leads go cold when they slip your mind. LeadWing watches for clients going quiet and surfaces them before you lose them — with a ready-to-send nudge. No spreadsheets, no reminders, nothing falling through the cracks.

everywhere.title: Works everywhere
everywhere.body: Desktop and mobile, and installable as an app on your phone's home screen.

data.title: Your data, yours only
data.body: Every agent's clients are fully isolated. Nobody sees your book but you.

setup.title: Nothing to set up
setup.body: Sign in and start adding clients. No training, no clutter, no per-seat sales calls.

pricing.body: Every feature on both plans. The only difference is how many clients you can hold.

faq.heading: Questions agents ask before they start
faq.body: Short answers to what we hear most. Anything else, just ask.

free.a: Yes. Free is free forever and includes every feature. It holds up to {limit} clients, buyers and sellers together, with no card and no time limit.

price.a: Pro is €{monthly} a month or €{yearly} a year, plus VAT, for unlimited clients. Everything else is identical to Free.

card.q: Do I need a card to start?
card.a: No. Sign in with Google or a one-time email code and start adding clients. You only enter a card if you upgrade to Pro.

agencies.q: I work with several agencies. Does that work?
agencies.a: That is exactly what LeadWing is built for. Tag each lead with the agency it belongs to and keep your whole book in one place, whoever the deal is with.

mobile.a: LeadWing is a web app that installs on your phone from the browser, so it opens from your home screen like any other app. No app store, nothing to update.

whatsapp.q: Can I send WhatsApp messages from LeadWing?
whatsapp.a: Yes. LeadWing drafts a warm, personal message in your client's language, you read it and tweak it, and one tap opens it in WhatsApp on your phone. Nothing is ever sent without you.

portals.q: Which portals does it work with?
portals.a: Paste an enquiry from Idealista, Fotocasa, Kyero, an email or a WhatsApp, and LeadWing fills in the lead for you: name, phone, language, budget. No retyping.

privacy.a: Only you. Every agent's clients are fully isolated; nobody sees your book but you, not even other agents at the same agency.

cancel.a: Any time, from the billing page. You go back to Free at the end of the period you have paid for, and nothing is deleted: everything stays visible and editable, you just can't add clients above the Free limit.

calendar.q: Does it sync with Google Calendar?
calendar.a: Yes. Viewings and meetings you book in LeadWing appear in Google Calendar through a calendar feed you subscribe to once, and LeadWing reminds you before each one.
